about_the_game:
“Miners in the Mountain” is a pixel card RPG with Tarkov-like survival. Fight, loot, and build bases in collapsing mines. Failure will cost you everything—food, components, crew members, all vanishes. Meet allies and foes, build your expedition squad deck, dig deeper, and find the Mountain's Heart.

Who am I? Where am I?

You were found unconscious in a mineral vein, rescued by ventilation technician Yue'er. No one in the Mining Bureau recognizes you. Your identity, name, memories—all gone, except one lingering promise: Find the Mountain’s Heart. Promise to whom ？
—Where should I go?

—“Weren't you the one sworn to find the Mountain’s Heart?”

Build Your Squad, Advance Cautiously

The tunnels swarm with dangers: mutated creatures and hostile miners attack without warning, while collapsing ceilings threaten to bury you mid-battle. Use resource and crew cards to hold positions, and reinforce camps with pit props. Every step brings you closer to the Mountain’s Heart.
—Where is it?
—“Deeper.”

One Misstep, Lose Everything

Every descent could be your last battle. Fail, and you’ll lose everything—food reserves, mechanical parts, loyal teammates—all swallowed by the dark. Stockpile backups in camp warehouses and pray it’s enough.
—What happens if I fail?
—“Death. Even if you escape alive, your supplies and comrades won’t.”

Descend Forever, Unearth Truths

As you plunge deeper, encounter all kinds of bizarre anecdotes. At the journey’s end lies the Mountain’s Heart—and the answer to your existence.
—Who are you?
—“The Mountain God.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R7 260x
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Directx-compatible sound card
